signals.description: 52 ARKit-style blendshape coefficients. NOT FACS action units. Several map near-1:1 (browDown~AU4, cheekSquint~AU6, mouthSmile~AU12) but the mapping is unvalidated, so these are emitted under blendshape.* names and must never be relabelled as AUs.

events.description: Face detection dropped below presence confidence

quality.description: Measured per session, never assumed. REPORT.md §2.1 measured 9-39 fps jittered across home setups; §5.3 uses 5 Hz as a published exclusion threshold.
Fraction of frames with a face above presence confidence. §2.2 measured 43% (AFFDEX) vs 62-63% (FaceReader/Py-Feat) on identical video.
§2.5: the rPPG skin-tone accuracy gap largely closes at luminance >=30 (2.25 bpm -> 0.21 bpm). The only quantified bias mitigation in the evidence base.

license.notes: Apache-2.0 covers the library. The .task model bundle's own licence line was NOT verified during research — re-verify before any commercial ship. Flagged rather than assumed.
